certifiedResults.title: New Mexico official presidential county results
certifiedResults.detail: County-level presidential rows are parsed from the official New Mexico Secretary of State Election Stats results CSV for the 2024 General Election President contest. The parser reconciles county candidate sums against the official State row.
certifiedResults.sourceTimestampBasis: Official New Mexico Secretary of State Election Stats contest export for 2024 Nov 5 General, President of the United States.

wardDetail.title: New Mexico precinct or reporting-unit detail
wardDetail.detail: The official contest CSV includes precinct rows, but this promotion imports county rows only. Review drilldowns need a mapped precinct review parser before they can be enabled.
wardDetail.sourceTimestampBasis: Contest export includes precinct rows beneath each county row.

turnout.title: New Mexico turnout denominator
turnout.detail: The official contest CSV includes total ballots cast for the presidential contest, but registered-voter denominators are not mapped. Turnout remains disabled until an official turnout or registration source is mapped.
turnout.sourceTimestampBasis: Contest export has total ballots cast but not registered-voter denominator fields.
